MUC16 p.S11377F. MUC16 is often mutated in various cancers but typically considered a passenger due to its large size and high mutation rate. In glioblastoma, MUC16 mutations are not known to be drivers. So passenger with high confidence. No therapeutic relevance, so No with high confidence.
